existing_features.title: Add a clear, user-facing way to add a real video to the Work Video section by supporting local video file upload (e.g., .mp4/.webm) and playing it inline with standard controls.
Make the default Work Video montage reliably render by validating default asset paths and adding a graceful fallback when an image fails to load.
Update the Work Video UI so it is obvious what content is being shown (uploaded video vs. photo montage), and provide a simple control to switch/clear the current selection.
